items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $161 from $189 at Morgan Stanley
items.snippet: Morgan Stanley analyst Vincent Andrews lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $161 from $189 and keeps an Equal Weight rating on the shares. Lithium prices have come off this cycle's peak.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $225 from $245 at Truist
items.snippet: Truist analyst Peter Osterland lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $225 from $245 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares. Albemarle continues to execute on cost efficiencies and capital discipline.

items.headline: [Materials] Albemarle Rises on Earnings as Global Lithium Demand Grows Faster Than Expected
items.snippet: Albemarle announced its Q2 earnings after the previous day's close, exceeding expectations for both earnings per share and sales. Global lithium demand is expanding at a pace exceeding expectations, outpacing supply growth.

items.headline: ALBEMARLE CORP files FORM 10-Q for Q2, FY 2026 on Aug 5, 2026
items.snippet: Energy Storage net sales and profitability are strongly dependent on lithium market prices, which are volatile. If the average lithium pricing for 2026 is in line with current prices, we expect Energy Storage net sales and profitability to increase year-over-year.

items.headline: Albemarle Stock Loses 25% in a Month: What Should Investors Do Now?
items.snippet: Albemarle Corporation's ALB shares have tumbled 25.5% in the past month, underperforming the Zacks Chemical - Diversified industry and the S&P 500. Falling lithium market prices are weighing on the ALB stock lately.
